title: dispatch-gates: check:published-readme-exports is never derived by --commands for a package-source diff (the one family #31257 left)
body:
domain:devx#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5njkh3xbcDN6EtSfw7

Filing-gate class **②** (the remainder of #31257, which its order routed to a seat-filed card). Measured by the #31257 card thread, os-dev report 6714099288, `out_of_scope_findings`. PR #31291 closes the other 17 of the 18 families.

## Measured

- `check:published-readme-exports` reads 129 published markdown docs of public packages outside `ui/`, plus the BUILT type entries of the 77 targets (68 packages) that their 268 import statements reach. A diff that removes or renames an exported member in one of those packages can red it, but `--commands` does not derive it for that diff.
- A path net over the 68 packages is close to "every package source", so it would derive the gate for nearly every card.
- The gate exits 3 on an unbuilt worktree, so a derived run also needs the reached packages built.

## Ask

Derive the gate precisely: a member-name net that reads the names each published doc imports and matches them against the declarations a diff removes or renames in the reached package. Measure recall against the gate's own reader, as PR #31254 and PR #31291 did. If no precise net is affordable, close the family by measurement and say why. Name the build prerequisite in the derived command, so a `--ran` reconciliation shows NOT MEASURED instead of a false green.

**Seat ruling, standing (from #30763):** `--commands` does not emit the roster or WIDE blocks wholesale, and `--ran` counts derived families only.

Level: repo tooling only (`scripts/pm/**`), `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. No `.github/**` edit.

Dedupe: "published readme exports derived", "readme import member net" and "dispatch-gates remainder" hit only #31257. **New.**

Related: #31257, PR #31291, #30763, PR #31254.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`, after PR #31291 lands.
